name: TxRacer Real-World Ordering Contract-Group Benchmark v1
sampleUnit: one real-world ordering-attack event or observed attack sequence together with its trace-derived smart-contract group

sources.CISBL7: Harvard Dataverse CISBL7, reorganized into unique observed sandwich sequences
sources.DeFiHackLabs: Ethereum Mainnet front-running and sandwich incidents selected from DeFiHackLabs

groupViews.historicalExecutionGroup: All historically executed contracts retained in metadata, including members without verified source and verified non-Solidity members.
groupViews.verifiedSolidityInputGroup: Execution-group members with public verified Solidity source, materialized under each sample's contracts directory for TxRacer.

limitations: CISBL7 sequence lengths are observed historical sequences, not minimized triggering witnesses.

Seven DeFiHackLabs groups contain one validated historical transaction; their multi-transaction ordering label relies on the PoC or incident report rather than a complete attacker-victim transaction sequence.
Verified non-Solidity contracts and contracts without public verified source remain in execution metadata but are excluded from TxRacer input directories.
Historical attack involvement does not by itself prove that every group member independently contains a Solidity-level vulnerability.
